intro: **The theme ways are drawn. Four questions, one link each.** Every figure below is computed from your lists, and so is every line on the map. The way *types* are our proposal, awaiting your ruling; the key on every view says so. Each link opens the city with those ways drawn and a key that says how each one was banded.

questions.title: Same width, very different reach
questions.template: Both band as {an:signs.type} **{signs.type}** ({signs.verses} and {belief-eternal-life.verses} verses), but {signs.label} touches {plural:signs.blocks:block} and {belief-eternal-life.label} {plural:belief-eternal-life.blocks:block}. Is "widest" the right reading for both — or should reach count as well as text?{pinches:signs}

questions.title: John {love-for-cosmos.refs}
